title: Three ways to read the game
question: Same Pacers–Thunder game, same point estimates. Choose the layout you would want to use.

options.label: Analytics desk
options.thesis: Every factor and the running balance in one working view.
options.viewport: Game and score at left, the ranked impact table in the center, and the point ledger at right.
options.risk: More information to scan; less relaxed on a small phone.

options.label: Sports editorial
options.thesis: The result and the biggest causes lead, with a chart you can read at a glance.
options.viewport: A compact score strip leads into a wide factor chart with a running deficit alongside.
options.risk: A stronger sports identity; less visually quiet than the Apple direction.

options.label: Apple Sports
options.thesis: A team-first matchup, one clear answer, and a calm comparison list.
options.viewport: The team matchup is central, with the turnover explanation and the full factor list below it.
options.risk: The most restrained of the three; it has less editorial character.
